answer.justification: The gastrohepatic ligament, a component of the lesser omentum, connects the liver to the lesser curvature of the stomach. Dividing it permits entry into the lesser sac posterior to the stomach, where the pancreatic body can be accessed during laparoscopic pancreatic surgery.

decision.reason: This is standard surgical anatomy about accessing the lesser sac; textbook knowledge suffices and a literature search is unlikely to improve reliability.
